title: ChatHealthy SpecialtyMedicare
description: One document per NUCC specialty code in the specialtyMedicarePartDQuantityRollUps collection (EPIC-010-F-007-S-009). For each molecule the specialty prescribes it carries the specialty_total (this NUCC's attributed usage), the de-duplicated molecule_real_total (across all specialties, each provider once), and the per-measure means of each -- specialty_mean and molecule_real_mean -- which are the norms a provider is scored against. provider_count is read from Provider_v_5. The per-specialty embedding is the vector FindCare's semantic search uses.

provider_count.description: providers carrying this NUCC in any taxonomy slot (Provider_v_5)

embedding.description: specialty embedding copied from the SMD collection (FindCare's semantic-search vector)

prescriber_count.description: distinct providers of this NUCC prescribing this molecule

real_prescriber_count.description: distinct providers prescribing this molecule across all specialties (the molecule_real_mean denominator)

measures.description: summed usage for the four quantitative measures

meanMeasures.description: per-prescriber mean of each quantitative measure (the norm)
